title: [review] project-LICHEN-2auf.44.11.1.1: build_context_2 ignores C_R and TH_2 (RFC 9528 method 0 violation)
description:
## Summary
RFC 9528 Section 6.3.3.3 defines for EDHOC method 0:


The new 4-arg  at  accepts  and  as parameters but ignores them (prefixed with ), only encoding  and . This means MAC_2 lacks the context binding to the specific transcript hash and connection identifier, which could allow signature replays across different EDHOC runs.

Same pattern applies to  at  - also accepts but ignores TH_3.
